$comment: Template for character prompt database with nested refinements. See readme.md for detailed instructions.

metadata.title: Character Prompt Template
metadata.description: Generic template for organizing AI image generation prompts with nested refinements

generic_render_rules.description: Universal rendering rules applied to all prompts
rules: single character, centered composition
full figure visible (head-to-toe / nose-to-tail), do not crop limbs or extremities
3/4 view for optimal silhouette readability
camera: 50-85mm equivalent focal length
lighting: 3-point lighting with strong rim light and soft key fill
overhead studio lighting (top-down key) with subtle rim light for edge definition
lighting style emphasizes readable silhouette and plane separation
materials/finish: unpainted grey resin miniature (uniform matte grey), like test print / unprimed model
stylization: tabletop-miniature aesthetic (clean graphic shapes, simplified primary forms, bold secondary forms, crisp plane breaks)
avoid photoreal skin/fur microtexture that reads as noise at scale
proportions: heroic scale (slightly exaggerated hands/heads/features and crisp planes)
texture guidance: prefer stylized, print-readable detail; fur/hair as bold clumps/tufts with deep grooves
avoid ultra-fine individual hairs, micro-fuzz, flyaways, and noisy microtexture
minimum detail size: ~0.3-0.5mm; prioritize crisp edges and strong plane breaks
background: NO background - transparent background / alpha cutout only, isolated subject silhouette
rendering style: stylized, sculpt-ready miniature render (not photoreal)
emphasize readable forms and primary/secondary shapes
output format: high resolution (4k/2048+)
printability: watertight, manifold geometry, no extremely thin elements (<1.5mm), balanced pose
generic_render_rules.prompt_snippet: single character, centered composition, full figure (head-to-toe / nose-to-tail), 3/4 view, 50-85mm lens, overhead studio lighting (top-down key) with subtle rim light, high contrast, sharp focus, unpainted grey resin miniature (uniform matte grey), sculpt-ready, high detail, stylized tabletop-miniature aesthetic (clean readable planes, graphic shapes, simplified forms; not photoreal), print-readable stylized fur/hair (bold clumps/tufts, deep grooves), avoid ultra-fine hair and noisy microtexture, heroic-scale tabletop miniature proportions (slightly exaggerated features; not strict realism), NO background at all, transparent background / alpha cutout only

thematic_rules.description: Theme-specific rules applied to all prompts. Use prompt_snippet for global theme, and refinement-level thematic_snippet for variant-specific theming.
thematic_rules.prompt_snippet: fantasy medieval setting, heroic high-fantasy aesthetic, dramatic lighting

miniature_scale_rules.description: Specific rules for miniature-scale rendering (typically 28mm-40mm tabletop scale)
rules: 40mm scale tabletop miniature
hard plastic/resin model appearance
crisp sculpted details
slightly exaggerated heroic proportions
studio product photo lighting
neutral seamless background (or transparent alpha)
softbox lighting with rim light
sharp focus with high depth detail
fine layer lines avoided
clean sculpted planes
readable edges and silhouette
miniature_scale_rules.prompt_snippet: 40mm scale tabletop miniature, hard plastic/resin model, crisp sculpted details, slightly exaggerated heroic proportions, studio product photo, neutral seamless background, softbox lighting with rim light, sharp focus, high depth detail, clean sculpted planes, readable edges
